description: Detects scaffolder silent defaults in restaurant page output. Restaurant has fewer legacy fallbacks than electrician, but placeholder content and generic defaults still need detection.

defaults.rationale: Placeholder phone number from the Asian Delight test config. Any real client config must replace this.
Generic placeholder email. Real client email required before publish.
Generic placeholder URL. Real client website required.
Electrician-specific terminology that must never appear in restaurant output. Detects cross-type template leaks.
Electrician-specific service/utility references that must never appear in restaurant output.
Restaurant pages must use @type Restaurant, not LocalBusiness or Service. Detects wrong schema type in output.
Electrician CSS prefix. Restaurant uses rst- prefix. Detects template leak.
